name: SOVEREIGN FRACTURE: Corponation Wars
description: A BCI-integrated grand strategy esport in which players assume direct neural command of fictional corponations, managing resource flows, espionage networks, and paramilitary contracts in a simulated Meridian economy. Sponsored by Valdris-Okafor Holdings, the professional league draws millions of viewers across Tiers 2-4, with top commanders earning Φ800K annual contracts. The game's hyper-accurate economic modeling was reportedly derived from actual corponation data, sparking an ongoing regulatory investigation.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 ranked player discovers their in-game decisions are being mirrored in real corponation policy and begins receiving anonymous threats.
An investigative journalist uses the game's economic engine to predict — and attempt to prevent — a hostile corporate takeover before it happens.
A pro league team is approached to throw a championship match, with the payout structured in untraceable geneware credits.
